objective: Recognize a correctly bounded agent loop (stop reasons, step caps, budgets, timeouts, loop detection, honest reporting) without false alarms.

rubric: repeated call detection|loop detection|same call repeated
read the traces|check the logs|find why it loops

narration.text: Our agent runs a loop: the model asks for a tool, our code runs it, and the result goes back in.
All our tools run in our own code, so the loop keeps going while the stop reason says tool use.
A final answer only means the model stopped asking for tools, so our code still checks the outcome.
Every run has a step cap of ten and a token budget, and hitting either one ends the run as unfinished.
An unfinished run is reported as unfinished and handed to a person, never shown as a success.
We set the cap at ten from our logs: almost every successful run finished in six steps or fewer.
Each tool call has its own timeout, so one slow service can't hang the whole run.
If the same tool is called with the same arguments three times in a row, we stop and flag a loop.
